description:
intent=i006 snapshot=s05 branch=pull-invalidates-pointer status=complete
finding location=net/decnet/dn_route.c:531-590 confidence=medium conclusion=dn_route_rx_long() saves ptr=skb->data, then pskb_may_pull(skb,21) may free/move the head, and the stale ptr is dereferenced for cb->dst/src/hops afterwards, giving a remote slab-UAF read on non-linear DNA_RT packets (medium confidence; needs CONFIG_DECNET and a frag-filled skb to trigger).
finding location=net/decnet/dn_route.c:571-595 confidence=medium conclusion=dn_route_rx_short() captures ptr=skb->data before pskb_may_pull(skb,6) and reads cb->dst/src/hops through the stale pointer afterwards, a remote slab-UAF read for short-header DNA_RT packets (medium confidence; same preconditions as the long-header variant).
finding location=net/decnet/dn_nsp_in.c:709-745 confidence=medium conclusion=dn_nsp_rx_packet() saves ptr=skb->data, calls pskb_may_pull(skb,2) which may free the head, then reads cb->nsp_flags and cb->dst_port through the stale ptr, a remote slab-UAF read in NSP packet classification (medium confidence; CONFIG_DECNET + non-linear skb required).
unresolved location=net/decnet/dn_nsp_in.c:130 conclusion=Verify whether dn_process_ack()'s *ptr reads after skb_pull(2) can touch non-linear bytes: skb->len>=2 does not imply 2 linear bytes at that offset, so a pull-based linearization is missing before lines 151/158.
unresolved location=net/bluetooth/l2cap_core.c:7005 conclusion=Re-read l2cap_core.c lines 5735-5760 and 7000-7020 to confirm whether the pre-pull data pointer is dereferenced after pskb_may_pull and whether HCI RX skbs can be non-linear.
unresolved location=drivers/net/wan/hdlc_fr.c:871 conclusion=Line-by-line check of fr_rx() (hdlc_fr.c 830-1000) for dereferences of 'data' after each pskb_may_pull, and whether the WAN driver can deliver non-linear skbs, is still pending.
coverage_gap=Callers of the three reported DECnet functions were traced only up to dn_route_rcv and the ETH_P_DNA_RT packet_type registration; no runtime reproducer or KASAN build was produced to empirically confirm the reallocation on a frag-backed DNA_RT skb.
coverage_gap=Non-linearity preconditions were assessed structurally (modern NAPI/GRO paths can deliver frag-backed skbs) but no per-driver audit of which configurations actually hand non-linear skbs to these legacy DECnet handlers was performed.
limitation=All three findings are hypotheses supported by source reading of the exact save/pull/use lines, not by execution; the triggering requires CONFIG_DECNET plus an incoming non-linear DECnet routing packet, and the old head is only freed when __pskb_pull_tail must actually reallocate (payload bytes in frags), so exploitability may be narrower than the seed's phonet case.
limitation=The coarse scanner's function-boundary heuristic (column-0 braces) can mis-scope large functions or macros, so a small number of false negatives among the 686 call sites cannot be excluded.
limitation=No git history, network access, or cross-snapshot comparison was used, per assignment constraints; only snapshot s05 was searched.
